run_multiprocess_llm_inference: run multiprocess LLM inference on a data loader with configurable number of worker processes
create_llm_client: create an LLMClient instance with an app name and optional cluster configuration
get_async_llm_response: get an async LLM response by passing data with messages or prompt and params
postprocess_llm_responses: postprocess LLM responses from a queue and write results to a JSON lines file
run_inference_process_wrapper: run an inference process wrapper that batches async LLM requests and puts results on a queue
